name: Sentura Provisioner
description: Coordinates self-provisioning of new SaaS integrations — files an approval request via sentura-approval, hands off to a browser-driven provisioning skill once approved, and records the credential reference returned by the skill into the secret store. Tracks every provisioning run as an auditable record.

dataDir.description: Directory for the provisioning request log. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/sentura-provisioner/

approvalDataDir.description: Override for the sentura-approval data directory. Defaults to ~/.openclaw/sentura-approval/ (must match the sibling extension's dataDir).

defaultRiskLevel.description: Risk level applied to provisioning requests when the caller does not specify one. Defaults to 'high' since creating new accounts is rarely safe to auto-approve.
